sourceText:
Jello Cheesecake
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:19am

Ingredients




1 (4 oz.) lime Jello
1 (4 oz.) strawberry Jello
1 (4 oz.) lemon Jello
4 unflavored Knox gelatin pkg
1 (8 oz.) cream cheese
1 can peaches, drained and chopped (can use more if desired)
1 can condensed milk

Preparation

1 FIRST LAYER: 2 Prepare lime Jello according to box instructions. Add 1 envelope Knox gelatin. Place in 13 x 9 container. Let set in refrigerator. 3 SECOND LAYER: 4 Cream cheese; add condensed milk and peaches; mix. Prepare lemon Jello according to box instruction. Add 2 envelops Knox. Add to cream cheese mixture. Place over first layer. Let set. 5 THIRD LAYER: 6 Prepare strawberry Jello according to box instructions. Add 1 envelope Knox. Place over second layer. Let set.
